name: Oc van
summary: Ốc vặn, also called ốc tực, is one of the Nguồn dishes of Minh Hóa, alongside ốc núi and cơm pồi.
howToEat: Ask for it by either name, ốc vặn or ốc tực.
where: Minh Hóa, where most Nguồn people live.
seoTitle: Oc van — Nguon snail, also oc tuc
seoDescription: Ốc vặn, also called ốc tực, is a Nguồn snail dish from Minh Hóa, alongside ốc núi and cơm pồi.
